about: The spec suite's coverage matrix. DreamNarrative.Spec.Coverage runs every test block under Tests/Spec and Tests/Samples with a trace on the ledger and counts cells: named facts about what the runtime did (IDnaTrace; the names are made in Source/DreamNarrativeTests/Private/Spec/DnaCoverage.cpp and at the runtime's trace points).
required: the suite must reach every one of these, or the coverage test fails.
pending: not reachable yet because the feature is not implemented; move them to required when it is.
outside: reachable only from C++ (game code, a save written under older names, a defensive path the compiler rules out); a test block cannot and need not reach them.
A cell the runtime reports that is listed nowhere also fails the coverage test, so the matrix grows with the runtime.

required.combo.choice.if+once: 选项同时带 if 与 once
required.combo.choice.if+id: 选项同时带 if 与 #id
required.combo.choice.once+id: 选项同时带 once 与 #id

outside.ledger.write.RefusedType: 编译期 DNS4001 拦下;只有 C++ 能写错类型
outside.ledger.write.RefusedDomain: 编译期 DNS4002 拦下;只有 C++ 能写集合外的 tag

outside.ledger.snapshot.dropped: 要带已删除 fact 的存档;由 C++ 覆盖
